questions.prompt: What does a wider beam primarily change?
options: The number of decoding candidates retained
The sample rate of the recording
questions.explanation: Beam search explores more hypotheses; it does not itself retrain the acoustic model.

questions.prompt: A rare part name is boosted. What regression should you check?
options: Only whether the boosted name appears more often
Whether the output file is larger
False matches on speech that does not contain the name
questions.explanation: Biasing can improve recall while creating false positives. Test both in-vocabulary and confusable negative examples.

questions.prompt: How should you judge adaptation to workshop speech?
options: Choose the largest model by default
Compare on held-out workshop audio and a general-domain set
questions.explanation: Held-out target-domain data measures the intended improvement; a general set exposes regressions.
